claims.assertion: Anéeka says Taygetans have a unified brain, faster connections, integrated artistic and mathematical thought, and ambidexterity.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
claims.qualifiers: They have up to 500 cm³ more brain volume.

claims.assertion: Anéeka says Urmah have a unified, cat-like brain; Alfrateans and Ummitas retain two lobes with stronger interhemispheric connections than humans.
claims.speaker: Anéeka

claims.assertion: Anéeka says Taygetan nerves carry more signal and support greater strength, but their faster metabolism makes them more vulnerable to stress overload.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
claims.qualifiers: She notes their lower stress tolerance.
